calculation_handling.description: The gross floor area of an ancillary building containing a laneway suite is excluded from the lot's total gross floor area and floor space index.
calculation_handling.gaps: Exclusion rule for gfa_m2 / fsi; the text omits 'of' ('gross floor area an ancillary building').

calculation_handling.description: The gross floor area of an ancillary building containing a laneway suite must be less than the gross floor area of the residential building on the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: The bound is the residential building's gross floor area, which shares the gfa_m2 target name; no separate DSL input exists, so no expression. The bound is strict ('less than').

units.disclosure: A laneway suite must be smaller in floor area than the house on the lot; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Regulation 10.5.60.50(2) (maximum floor area of an ancillary building) does not apply to an ancillary building containing a laneway suite.
The gross floor area of a laneway suite building may be reduced by the areas listed in 10.5.40.40(1), (2) and (3)(A) and (B).
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies the principal-building GFA exclusions to the laneway suite building; needs the suite's floor plan.

150.8.60.50(1).explanation: A laneway suite's floor area does not count toward the lot's total floor area or floor space index.

150.8.60.50(2).explanation: A laneway suite must have less floor area than the house on the lot.

150.8.60.50(3).explanation: The general size cap on accessory buildings does not apply to a laneway suite.

150.8.60.50(4).explanation: When measuring a laneway suite's floor area, the same exclusions as for a house (such as certain basement and mechanical areas) may be subtracted.
